data.name: Essy
data.gender_notes: Essy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Essa', meaning 'God's Essence'. In ancient Greece, 'Essa' was revered as a goddess of the earth and fertility. In Christianity, Essy represents the divine feminine and spiritual growth. The name Essy carries the meaning “God's Essence” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Essy usually hope their child will grow to embody god's essence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the divine feminine and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Essy belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Essence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Essy total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אסי
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא ישועתי - God is my salvation
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אסי מקורו בעברית ומשמעותו אלוהים הוא ישועתי. הוא קשור קשר הדוק למושג הישועה והצלה, ומשמש כזכר לחסדו ולעוצמתו של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Εσση
in_greek.meaning: Ελευθερία από τον Θεό - Freedom from God
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εσση έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή γλώσσα και συνδέεται με την έννοια της σωτηρίας και της απελευθέρωσης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την ελευθερία που προσφέρει ο Θεός.

in_latin.name: Essy
in_latin.meaning: Deus salus mea - God my salvation
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Essy originem in lingua hebraica habet et significat Deus salus mea. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc exprimit fidem in salutem et liberationem per Deum.

in_english.name: Essy
in_english.meaning: God is my salvation or God delivers
in_english.long_meaning: The name Essy originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the phrase 'El is my salvation.' It signifies trust in God's deliverance and salvation. Historically, the name reflects a deep spiritual connection and reliance on divine providence. In Christian tradition, Essy symbolizes faith, hope, and redemption through Christ.

data.cultural_impact: The name Essy holds a unique cross-cultural significance. Historically, in ancient Greece, Essa was considered a goddess of the earth and fertility, emphasizing the importance of nature and the divine feminine. With the spread of Christianity, the name transformed to represent the divine essence and presence of God. This dual meaning highlights the fusion of Greek and Christian beliefs and the enduring influence of Greek culture on Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Essy encapsulates the spiritual growth and divine presence within an individual. Given its Greek origins as the goddess of essence and Earth, Essy represents the earthly manifestation of the divine and serves as a reminder of the spiritual connection to the Creator. The name also evokes the concept of God's essence, which is present within each person and guides their journey towards spiritual enlightenment.
